rationale: Measured: KERL does not calculate competitive multi-DEX routes or provide quotes on mainnet (56).
Measured: On mainnet Smart Swap uses @pancakeswap/smart-router over Melega factory pairs; KERL authority is false.
Measured: On testnet (97) KERL replaces Smart Router quotes with certified-pair wrapper execution — still Melega-only liquidity.
Measured: ACTIVE Treasury Runtime dependencies = 0 (pass), but that alone does not satisfy KEEP criteria.
Measured: No unique routing intelligence, no multi-DEX aggregation, large inactive/gated surface (signing-gate missing, dry-run stack).
Decision rule: do not preserve KERL only because it exists; evidence fails KEEP gates and meets DECOMMISSION gates for production Smart Swap architecture.
scopeNote: DECOMMISSION means remove KERL from production Smart Swap / mainnet activation architecture. Historical testnet KRMP artifacts may be archived; this audit does not delete code.
nextStepsIfAccepted: Plan separate decommission mission (out of scope here)
Keep Smart Swap → Smart Router / V2 → wallet architecture
Do not expand Smart Swap aggregation in this mission
